summary: The Greatest American was a four-part American television series hosted by Matt Lauer in 2005. It presented biographies and lists of influential people in U.S. history and ended with a contest in which millions of viewers nominated and voted for the person they considered the "greatest American". The competition was run by AOL and the Discovery Channel and covered by the BBC.
